story_type: parachute team POV jump into a stadium
hook: His view, steering a parachute down into a NASCAR speedway.
narration: This is a parachutist's view, steering his canopy straight down into a NASCAR speedway.
He is a soldier on the U.S. Army Parachute Team, jumping into Martinsville Motor Speedway in Virginia.
The jump was part of the pre-race show for a NASCAR race on November first.
He steers with two toggles. Pulling one turns the canopy, and pulling both at the last second flares it to slow the landing.
Down below, the track came up fast as he lined up his approach.
outcome: He came down over the track and landed on the orange target.
title: Parachuting into a NASCAR speedway
description:
Point of view footage from a U.S. Army Parachute Team soldier jumping into Martinsville Motor Speedway in Virginia on Nov. 1, 2026, part of the pre-race events for the NASCAR race.
